---
name: pdf_tools
description: Extract text, tables and images from PDF files, merge and split PDFs, fill in PDF forms, and convert scanned pages to searchable text with OCR, for any task that touches a PDF.
license: MIT
metadata:
  author: acme
  version: "1.2.0"

Use this skill whenever the user hands you a PDF.

- To extract text: read the file page by page and keep the page numbers.
- To merge or split: keep the original page order unless asked otherwise.
- To fill a form: list the form's fields first, then ask for any value you do not have.
